title: Quick Crumbly Indian Epoisses Rasam
description: A resinous, low‑calorie rasam that marries traditional Tamil spices with crumbled Epoisses cheese, finished with a flambé touch for a dramatic flavor burst.
instructions: Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat and add the vegetable oil.
When the oil is hot, add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, dried red chilies, and a pinch of asafoetida, letting them pop for 30 seconds.
Stir in the diced tomato and cook until the tomato softens, about 3 minutes.
Add the tamarind paste, salt, and water, then bring the mixture to a gentle boil.
Reduce the heat and let the rasam simmer for 7 minutes to meld the flavors.
Stir in the curry leaves and let them release their aroma for 1 minute.
Add the crumbled Epoisses cheese, stirring until it is partially melted and the soup thickens slightly.
Pour the brandy into the pan, cover the pot, and carefully ignite with a long lighter to flambé, allowing the flames to subside.
Return the pot to the stove and simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with a pinch of salt if needed.
Ladle the rasam into bowls and serve hot.
Garnish with a drizzle of fresh cilantro if desired.
